Hosts, bindings and grants · Encrypted credentials · Execution audit · Tool access

Verify server public keys through an independent trusted route before registration. Ordinary and sudo bindings require different accounts and credentials. Confirmed execution requires Allow writes, a writable host and current caller grants. Changing policy or grants fences connections and interrupts active commands; inspect remote state before preparing another uncertain command.
